limitations: Building footprints and roads follow OSM; this is an extruded map, not photogrammetry.
Building heights use explicit OSM height where present, otherwise 3.3 m per recorded floor or a documented default. Facade details, textures and roof profiles are visual approximations.
Available multipolygon courtyard and island holes are included as metadata; the scene renderer must support them. Polygon geometry is simplified within 0.55 m.

The route has an approximate Copernicus GLO-90 elevation profile; city feature elevations are interpolated for the scene. Signal positions are mapped where available, but signal cycles, right of way and traffic are synthetic.
The dataset is clipped to a corridor to control download size and rendering load.

buildingPartsEnrichment.method: Ground-contact body parts covering at least 60% of the footprint, with principal eaves spanning at most 3.3 m and recorded levels spanning at most one floor. Eaves use height minus roof:height, flat recorded height, or the existing 3.3 m/level conversion.
buildingPartsEnrichment.limitations: Footprints and counts are unchanged. Coherent principal bodies produce one coarse extrusion, not individual 3D parts. Roof-only, elevated and small tower parts are ignored; ambiguous complexes are untouched. Original attributes and exact source tags are preserved per changed building. Without recorded roof height, pitched parts require recorded levels and retain the existing 3.3 m/level conversion.
